snippet.title: Off-the-Ground Survival - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
“Off-the-Ground Survival” is a survival role-playing game, releases on Nintendo Switch and PS5 on oct.1st.
Trapped on the top floor, 99 stories off the ground, you hope to reach the ground floor and escape. With limited food and supplies, find your exit and survive the apocalypse!
